title: Problem
问题
html:
RLVR assumes that a verifier can separate correct from incorrect outputs, yet executable tests miss cases and model judges make systematic mistakes. If optimisation follows this feedback, false positives can reinforce wrong programs and false negatives can suppress valid ones, so measured reward can diverge from actual task success and the required verifier quality remains unclear.

This study makes verifier error an experimental variable for code generation and scientific reasoning. It introduces controlled reward noise or a model judge while retaining ground-truth checks for evaluation, yielding an empirical robustness threshold and guidance on precision versus recall.

RLVR 依赖验证器把正确输出与错误输出区分开，但可执行测试会漏掉边界情形，模型裁判也会稳定地产生误判。优化一旦跟随这类反馈，假阳性会把错误程序当作奖励目标，假阴性会压低有效解法，测得奖励便会偏离真实任务成效，因此很难知道验证器达到何种质量后训练仍然可信。

论文把验证器误差变成代码生成和科学推理中的可控实验变量：一类实验人为注入奖励噪声，另一类以模型裁判替代真实测试，同时保留真实检查器作评估参照。它由此给出学习对噪声的经验阈值，并回答应优先提高精确率还是召回率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core object is the RLVR verifier as a fallible reward channel: the paper measures how deliberately corrupted or model-produced judgments alter learning while an oracle remains available for evaluation. This turns the usual all-or-nothing assumption about verifier correctness into a robustness curve, separating the effects of error rate, error granularity, and judge precision. It shows that precision is more consequential than recall for this setting and that useful learning can survive moderate noise. It uses the existing MBPP coding benchmark and GPQA science questions, but the authors do not package their training records as an official downloadable dataset or release a complete codebase.

本文的核心对象是会出错的 RLVR 验证器，并把它看作一条不完美的奖励通道：研究者在保留真实检查器作评估基准的前提下，测量人为污染或模型产生的判断怎样改变学习结果。这样便把“验证器必须完全正确”的二元假设改写为一条可量化的鲁棒性曲线，区分错误率、错误粒度和裁判精确率造成的影响，指出在该设置中精确率比召回率更关键，且中等噪声下训练仍可能有效。论文使用既有的 MBPP 编程基准和 GPQA 科学问题，但作者没有把训练记录打包为正式可下载数据集，也未发布完整代码库。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build oracle rewards. For each MBPP prompt, sample code rollouts and run each program against ground-truth unit tests; the passed-test fraction is the clean reward.
  1. Inject controlled error. Flip pass/fail outcomes with probability p at cell, rollout, test, or whole-group granularity and recompute reward. Training receives the corrupted decision, not the oracle.
  1. Substitute a model judge. A language model reads generated code and an assertion, emits pass or fail, and its pass fraction becomes reward; retained oracle tests compute its accuracy, precision, and recall.
  1. Optimise reasoning models. Train Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B with GRPO on MBPP; use Qwen3-8B and GSPO for the GPQA transfer setting. Clean and imperfect conditions share the task configuration.
  1. Evaluate the policy. Held-out unit-test pass rate is the MBPP outcome. Noise sweeps, judge-size comparisons, and GPQA test whether the conclusion survives changed feedback sources and domains.
  1. Set reproduction boundaries. The appendix gives a script and selected hyperparameters, but no complete official code or dataset. Most noisy conditions have one seed; fix the reported template, sampling settings, model versions, and tests, then audit false positives and negatives separately.

1. 构造真实奖励。 对每个 MBPP 题目采样代码回答，用单元测试执行，通过比例即为干净奖励。
  1. 注入可控误差。 按概率 p 在单个测试、单条回答、测试列或整组回答层面翻转通过与失败，重算奖励；训练接收的是污染判定，不是真实判定。
  1. 换用模型裁判。 语言模型读取生成代码和断言，输出通过或失败，以通过比例给奖；保留真实测试以计算准确率、精确率和召回率。
  1. 优化推理模型。 在 MBPP 上用 GRPO 训练 Qwen3-8B 和 GLM4-9B；在 GPQA 迁移设置中用 Qwen3-8B 和 GSPO，干净与不完美条件共享任务配置。
  1. 评估所得策略。 以留出题单元测试通过率为 MBPP 指标，并用噪声扫描、裁判规模比较和 GPQA 检验结论能否跨反馈来源与领域成立。
  1. 设定复现边界。 附录给出脚本和部分超参数，但没有完整官方代码或数据集。多数噪声条件只有一个种子；复现须固定文中模板、采样设置、模型版本和测试，并分别审计假阳性与假阴性。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The decisive experiment holds the MBPP task, Qwen3-8B base model, training data, budget, and recipe fixed, then replaces clean group-level code-verification rewards with independently resampled symmetric noise. This controlled design isolates reward error within the stated recipe, so the difference is principally attributable to the reward decision rather than changed data or compute. Clean rewards reach a mean validation unit-test pass rate of 0.901, while 10% noise reaches 0.886 (Table 1); across the sweep, the best validation score remains within two percentage points of the clean baseline up to 15% noise. This supports tolerance to moderate noise in this coding configuration, not robustness to persistent or asymmetric errors, larger models, or arbitrary verifier failures.

决定性实验固定 MBPP 任务、Qwen3-8B 基座模型、训练数据、预算和训练配方，只把干净的组级代码验证奖励换成每轮独立重采样的对称噪声；这一受控设计在既定配方内隔离了奖励误差，因此差异主要可归因于奖励判定，而非数据或计算变化。干净奖励的验证集平均单元测试通过率为 0.901，百分之十噪声为 0.886（表 1）；在完整扫描中，噪声不超过百分之十五时，最佳验证分数仍与干净基线相差不到两个百分点。该结果支持这种编程配置可容忍中等噪声，却不能证明它能抵抗持续性或非对称误差、更大模型或任意类型的验证器失效。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Nearby RLVR practice typically treats a programmatic verifier as ground truth or reports a single model judge without locating its error tolerance. This paper changes the comparison object: it perturbs the verifier's individual decisions at several granularities while preserving an oracle reward for online diagnosis, then compares that controlled contract with actual model verifiers. The contribution is therefore a causal robustness study of reward errors, not a new policy-optimisation algorithm or a claim that an LLM judge is universally sufficient. Its practical distinction is that it separates precision from recall and finds false positives, reflected in low precision, more damaging than missed correct answers in the tested setting.

相近的 RLVR 实践通常把程序验证器当作真值，或只报告一个模型裁判的结果，却不定位训练究竟能容忍多大误差。本文改变的是比较对象：它在保留真实奖励作在线诊断的同时，按多种粒度扰动验证器的单次判定，再把这种受控契约与真实模型验证器比较。因此新意不是提出新的策略优化算法，也不是宣称语言模型裁判在任何场景都足够，而是对奖励误差进行因果式鲁棒性研究。其实际区分度在于：它分开考察精确率和召回率，发现被测设置中低精确率带来的假阳性比漏掉正确答案更有破坏性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors test only three model families, with the central runs concentrated on Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B in coding plus a smaller science transfer; the threshold may not hold for larger models, other architectures, or other domains. Reuse should repeat the sweep on the target task rather than treating 15% as a universal allowance.

Their synthetic errors are symmetric and resampled each epoch, whereas deployed judges can have persistent, prompt-dependent, and asymmetric false-positive/false-negative patterns. Before training, measure those two error rates separately on representative outputs and test fixed-noise conditions.

Most noisy settings have a single seed and the release lacks a complete official codebase and dataset. This makes small differences and implementation choices harder to audit; reproduction should add seeds, preserve the reported chat template and sampling configuration, and independently reimplement the reward path.

作者只测试三个模型家族，核心实验集中在编程任务上的 Qwen3-8B 和 GLM4-9B，科学迁移实验规模也较小；该阈值未必适用于更大模型、其他架构或其他领域。复用时应在目标任务上重做扫描，不能把百分之十五当作通用容许值。

合成误差是对称的，且每轮都会重采样；部署中的裁判却可能随提示变化、持续存在，并呈现不对称的假阳性和假阴性。训练前应在代表性输出上分别测量两类错误率，并检验固定噪声条件。

多数噪声设置只有一个随机种子，且没有完整官方代码库和数据集发布。这会使小差异和实现选择难以审计；复现应增加种子数，固定文中的聊天模板与采样配置，并独立重建奖励路径。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For a team building code RLVR, start with prompts, candidate programs, and a trusted test suite. Apply the paper's perturbation protocol to the reward path, train the same base model under clean and noisy feedback, and output a task-specific robustness report; success is a held-out unit-test score that stays near the clean condition. Do not transfer the reported threshold if tests lack reliable ground truth.

For a team considering an LLM judge, collect judge decisions and oracle labels on representative generated programs. Compute precision and recall, then use the judge only when its false-positive profile is acceptable; the output is an evidence-backed go/no-go decision or a need for stricter verification. Do not use accuracy alone to approve a judge.

构建代码 RLVR 的团队可准备题目、候选程序和可信测试集，把论文的扰动协议施加在奖励路径上，再以同一基座模型分别在干净与含噪反馈下训练，输出任务专属的鲁棒性报告；成功标准是留出题的单元测试分数仍接近干净条件。若测试本身没有可靠真值，就不应直接迁移文中的阈值。

考虑采用语言模型裁判的团队可在代表性生成程序上同时收集裁判判定和真实标签，计算精确率与召回率；仅当假阳性模式可接受时才启用裁判，输出应是有证据支持的采用或加严验证决定。不能只凭准确率批准一个裁判。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Decision. The paper asks how much verifier error RLVR can tolerate and answers: moderate noise can still support learning, but the answer is configuration-specific.
  1. Mechanism. Build clean unit-test rewards first, corrupt the pass/fail matrix or replace it with a model judge, then keep the oracle only for diagnosis; the reward path is the quality-critical component.
  1. Artifacts. MBPP and GPQA are reused benchmarks, not a newly released dataset. An appendix links a reproduction script, but there is no complete official codebase or downloadable training set.
  1. Evidence. With Qwen3-8B on MBPP, clean reward scores 0.901 and 10% group-level noise scores 0.886; the claimed tolerance only covers independently resampled symmetric noise.
  1. Reuse decision. Use this as a verifier-audit recipe for code tasks with trusted tests; before deployment, separately measure false positives and false negatives and rerun multiple seeds.

1. 定位。 论文问 RLVR 能容忍多大验证误差，答案是中等噪声仍可支持学习，但结论依赖具体配置。
  1. 方法抓手。 先构造干净单元测试奖励，再污染通过失败矩阵或换成模型裁判，并仅把真实检查器留作诊断；奖励路径决定质量。
  1. 数据与产物。 MBPP 和 GPQA 是复用基准，不是新发布的数据集。附录链接了复现脚本，但没有完整官方代码库或可下载训练集。
  1. 证据锚点。 Qwen3-8B 在 MBPP 上用干净奖励得 0.901，组级百分之十噪声得 0.886；所称容忍性只覆盖独立重采样的对称噪声。
  1. 复用决定。 它适合作为有可信测试集的代码任务的验证器审计配方；部署前须分别测假阳性和假阴性，并以多个随机种子重跑。
